clues: This city sits on the southern coast of Cyprus, an island in the Mediterranean Sea. Its suburbs stretch far along that same shore.
Summer here is the longest season, lasting about six months of sun with hardly any rain. In spring, dust from the Sahara can dull the air.
This city was built between two ancient Greek cities, long ago. Its first streets rose in the space that lay between those two much older cities.
In twenty fourteen, this city made a world list of best new travel spots. A famed travel site put it third in the whole world.
Its old centre grew up around a medieval castle and the old port. Those two old landmarks still mark the heart of town today.
